messages:
Riley AE: Need quick routing help  Orion Labs POC asking for 90-day eval + 45% conditional discount on Dedicated if they convert within 180 days. Can Deal Desk approve and which CPQ template should I use?

Anya (Deal Desk): @Riley AE discounts >30% route to Deal Desk. Fields needed in SF: Deal_Type__c=POC, Discount_Approval_Level__c=DealDesk, Discount_Requested__c=45, Approval_Route__c=DealDesk_POC. Use CPQ template POC-Enterprise-2025. Typical turnaround 48h, add Legal if Needs_Legal_Review=true.

Sam SE: For pricing we recommend a PostConversionDiscount line applied on hourly rate. I'll draft the POC SOW SLA appendix and prepare SecurityQA responses.

June RevOps: Paste this exact block into opp internal note so automation catches it:
Deal_Type__c = POC; Discount_Requested__c = 45; Approval_Route__c = DealDesk_POC; Quote_Template__c = POC-Enterprise-2025; Needs_Legal_Review__c = true
Also set Opportunity Stage = 'POC - Submitted'.

Riley AE: They insist discount apply to converted committed hourly rate, not rebate. Also asking that we auto-escalate to Director if ACV > $400k. Can RevOps add that?

June RevOps: Yes I can add workflow: if ACV >= 400000 and Discount_Requested__c >= 40 then Approval_Route__c -> DealDesk_DirectorEscalation. Will deploy rule now.

Percy Dir: I can approve up to 50% for strategic deals with ACV >= $750k and Legal signoff on SLA. If this opp is strategic ping me on the Deal Desk ticket.

deal-bot: Ticket created: DD-4710 -> "Orion Labs POC / 45% conditional discount". Deal Desk ETA 48h. Legal ETA 72h if flagged.

Anya (Deal Desk): Once opp is submitted I'll validate CPQ lines and confirm whether Director escalation is required. :thumbsup:

Riley AE: Uploading SOW + SecurityQA now, will set SF fields per checklist and submit. Thanks everyone.
